        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    n=len(g); pts=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if g[i][j]!=0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if len(pts)<2: return out
    # infer step from consecutive same-color points on a diagonal
    ones=sorted(p for p in pts if g[p[0]][p[1]]==1)
    dr=ones[1][0]-ones[0][0]; dc=ones[1][1]-ones[0][1]
    r,c=ones[-1]
    while True:
        r+=dr; c+=dc
        if not(0<=r<n and 0<=c<n): break
        out[r][c]=2
    return out
import json
assert f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output']
out=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out))
